content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.ratelimit.rejections" | summarize rejections = sum(Sum) by reason = tostring(Properties["reason"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
content.title: Rejections by reason

content.query: let r = AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.ratelimit.rejections" and tostring(Properties["reason"]) in ("rate", "concurrency", "quota_day", "quota_month") | summarize rejected = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h); AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "docchat-api" and Name == "POST /v1/chat/turns" | summarize requests = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | join kind=leftouter r on TimeGenerated | extend rejectedPct = round(100.0 * coalesce(rejected, 0.0) / requests, 2) | project TimeGenerated, rejectedPct
content.title: Rejection share of chat requests

content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "docchat-api" and ResultCode == "429" | summarize users = dcount(UserAuthenticatedId) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Distinct users rejected per hour, by operation

content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "docchat-api" and ResultCode == "429" | summarize responses = sum(ItemCount) by Name
content.title: Every 429 by operation

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.usage.record_failures" | summarize failures = sum(Sum)
content.title: Usage-recording failures
